limitation_note: This student's engagement/submission pattern on the top-ranked features resembled the not-at-risk population by day 28, even though their ultimate outcome was at-risk. This is an inherent limitation of a day-28 cutoff: a student who disengages AFTER the cutoff is, by construction, invisible to a model that only sees pre-cutoff data. A later secondary check-in (e.g. day 56) would be needed to catch this pattern.
